items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: INTERVIEWER: When we first came to the U.S. for the first time I saw Jimi Hendrix on television. Was it “The Dick Cavett Show?” [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, “The Dick Cavett Show.”
